summary: Backend + frontend validation of the SecureStore race-condition fix in /app/frontend/src/api.ts (retry 3x + short-circuit only on `_isLoggedOut && requiresAuth(path)`). Backend: 23/23 pytest assertions PASS. Verified login/signup/anonymous all work, /auth/anonymous can be called twice back-to-back (post-logout scenario), and feeds/archive/hashtag/categories all tolerate calls without an Authorization header (either 200 optional-auth or well-formed 401 — NO 5xx). Comment/reply DELETE (owner branch) confirmed functional after the api.ts refactor. Frontend: launched mobile viewport 390x844, verified auth screen renders with EMAIL/GOOGLE/ANONIMO tabs (regression #1 clear), anonymous login navigates to Terms/NDA screen, terms+NDA acceptance transitions to Home feed with 6 feud cards + 11 category chips rendered, and FlashList content persists after a 30s idle wait (no cascade-empty regression). Archive screen loads with 82 items on 'IERI' + feuds visible — no removeClippedSubviews regression observed. One latent code-review finding: PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES is missing '/auth/signup' and '/auth/resend-verification', which means a user who logs out then tries to signup/resend WITHOUT restarting the app would hit the frontend short-circuit. This is a pre-existing edge case, unrelated to today's race fix, but worth flagging.

minor.issue: Signup returns {requires_verification: true, ...} without a token when email verification is enabled. Not a bug — expected behaviour; the frontend handles the branching. Documented here for future test authors.

action_items: LATENT BUG (unrelated to today's fix, worth patching in the same PR): PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES in /app/frontend/src/api.ts is missing '/auth/signup' and '/auth/resend-verification'. Impact: after an explicit logout (`_isLoggedOut=true`), if the user taps 'Registrati' or 'Reinvia email' in the SAME session (no app restart), the client short-circuits with ApiError(401, 'Sessione terminata') before the request ever leaves the device — signup and resend-verification are effectively blocked post-logout until process restart. Fix: add '/auth/signup' and '/auth/resend-verification' to the PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES array (line 85 of api.ts). No backend change required.

Cosmetic: the console emits deprecation warnings on every mount — 'shadow*' style props deprecated, 'textShadow*' style props deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. These are not introduced by this fix but keep leaking noise. Consider a sweep to migrate to `boxShadow`/`textShadow`/`style.pointerEvents`.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts: `requiresAuth(path)` gate on the `_isLoggedOut` short-circuit is CORRECT and preserves the login-after-logout flow — the previous fix that broke APK login had removed this gate, this iteration reinstates it. Verified /auth/login, /auth/anonymous, /auth/google-session, /auth/firebase-session all match the PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES list.
api.ts: the 3-retry SecureStore read (immediate + 100ms + 300ms) is bounded and cheap (<= 400ms worst case) — no risk of blocking the UI thread on cold start. Good backoff.

api.ts: dropping the client-side 401 on null token means the backend now decides. Public endpoints (categories/professions/legal/feuds/archive/hashtags) all return 200 without a token (verified in 23 tests), so the feed no longer empties on a transient SecureStore null. Correct call.

api.ts: PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES uses `startsWith`, but '/auth/signup' does NOT startsWith '/auth/register' (see action_items). This is a bug latent since the endpoint was renamed signup→register at some point in history. Same for '/auth/resend-verification' vs '/auth/verify' (the latter matches '/auth/verify-email' but not resend).

index.tsx / archive.tsx / top.tsx / notifications.tsx: removeClippedSubviews removal verified on live web preview — FlashList still renders 6 home cards + 82 archive cards without any clipping/blanking anomalies in a 30s idle window. FlashList's default recycling behaviour is enough for these list sizes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (auth screen load, anonymous login, terms/NDA accept, home feed render, 30s idle persistence, archive screen render)

seed_data_creation: Creates ephemeral anonymous users via /api/auth/anonymous (no persistence beyond the test module). Creates one TEST_-prefixed comment + one TEST_-prefixed reply on a random feud and deletes them within the same test — no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The race-condition bug being fixed manifests ONLY on Android APK / mobile browser deployed builds after ~60s of continuous use — expo-secure-store transient null on getToken(). It CANNOT be reliably reproduced in web preview, so we validate the FIX by contract: (a) backend tolerates no-Authorization on all list endpoints (23-test suite pins this down), (b) the client-side 401 short-circuit only fires on explicit logout, (c) all auth paths in PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES actually match the endpoints the api client calls. If reproducing on APK, watch for a stale `_isLoggedOut=true` after a manual logout — the fix keeps the requiresAuth() gate so login/anonymous still go through.
rca_of_issue: Prior code short-circuited request() with ApiError(401) whenever getToken() returned null. On Android, expo-secure-store has a transient write-behind window where getToken() can return null for tens of milliseconds even after a successful setToken(). During background polling (Notifications/Messaging tick every 30s), a null-token read would produce a fake 401. Consumers catch and setFeuds([]) → all lists empty in cascade. Fix retries getToken() up to 3x with 0/100/300ms backoff before deciding — and only bails out on the explicit `_isLoggedOut` flag. Backend now decides the auth outcome (200 optional-auth or real 401), which the 23-test suite has pinned down.
